text: It reads fourteen public agent trajectory datasets, trace files and live agent runs into one run record, and hands that record to the tools you already use.
Load a dataset by name. Each run keeps its steps, tool calls, outcome, and the dataset's own labels, like this expert-marked mistake.
Who and When, TRAIL and MAST label failures in different ways. One labels table holds all three.
Turn runs into OpenAI-style chat rows for fine-tuning and evaluation, with tool calls kept as function calls.
Capture your own Pydantic AI or OpenAI Agents SDK agent, and its runs land in the same record.
Then open any run in Phoenix, Jaeger or MLflow.
